events.title: Demo Update: Voice Chat, Lobby Management & Minor Fixes

You can now communicate directly with your teammates during exploration without relying on external voice applications. Lobby Management We also improved lobby management. events.title: Navigation Improvements, Shy Guy Audio Changes and Minor Fixes
events.summary: New Demo Update Available Hi everyone, we have released another small update for the Liminal Backrooms demo. This update focuses on improving navigation during the final part of the offshore platform tutorial, balancing the Shy Guy's audio presence and fixing several minor issues. Improved Navigation to the Captain's Cabin We have added new environmental guidance to make the path back to the Captain's Cabin easier to understand. events.title: New Objective Tracker Added to the Demo
events.summary: New Objective Tracker Added to the Demo Hi everyone, we have released a new small update for the Liminal Backrooms demo. After watching players explore the offshore platform and reading your feedback, we noticed that some objectives were clear, but finding their location could sometimes take too long. To improve the pacing of the introductory level, we have added a new Objective Tracker. How does it work? For selected objectives, you can now press Q to display the distance to the current target.

events.title: Achievements, DirectX 11 Support and Minor Fixes
events.summary: New Demo Update Available Hi everyone, we have released a new update for the Liminal Backrooms demo. This update introduces Steam achievements, adds DirectX 11 compatibility and includes several minor bug fixes and improvements. Steam Achievements Steam achievements are now available in the demo. Some will unlock naturally as you progress, while others may require you to explore carefully, survive certain encounters or pay attention to what is happening around you. Can you unlock them all?
